profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: Manage your account, theme preference and sessions · Click outside or press Esc to close
profile.communityTitle: This project is published and discussed in the LINUX DO community
profile.aboutDesc: WorkBuddy Manager is an account-pool console and OpenAI-compatible gateway built for workbuddy2api, with QR onboarding for multiple accounts, automatic check-in, key distribution, IP control and usage statistics.
profile.logoutDesc: You will need to enter your username and password again to access the console.
profile.revoked: All sessions revoked — please sign in again
profile.revokeHint: Invalidate every issued sign-in credential server-side (no password change needed)
profile.revokeDesc: Every signed-in session (including this one) is invalidated immediately and you will need to sign in again. Use it when you suspect a credential was captured — e.g. you signed in on someone else's computer, an old device is still signed in, or a backup contains the cookie. It is stronger than Sign out: sign-out only clears this device, revocation voids every credential on the server.
profile.totpOnDesc: Signing in also requires the 6-digit code from your authenticator.
profile.totpOffDesc: When enabled, signing in requires a rotating code in addition to your password, reducing the impact of a leaked password.
profile.totpHint: Scan the URI or enter the secret in Google Authenticator, 1Password or similar, then enter the generated code to activate.
profile.totpDisableDesc: Disabling requires both your current password and a verification code, so a single code cannot remove the second factor.
profile.totpRecoveryDesc: If you lose your phone, sign in with any unused recovery code. Each code works once — write them down now.

accounts.badgeManualDisabledTitle: You disabled this account upstream: it will not be picked for traffic, but it stays in the pool — check-in, token keep-alive and other jobs keep running, and its credentials and credits stay live. Click "Enable" on the right to resume at any time.

Consider signing in again or deleting it.

accounts.badgeUnknownTitle: The upstream status is currently unavailable (its container may have just restarted or be temporarily unreachable), so this account's availability cannot be determined. It retries automatically; locally known details (such as token expiry) are still accurate.

backupPanel.title: Backup & restore
backupPanel.desc: A backup packs the control-plane database into a self-verifying archive (zip + manifest + sha256) in the directory below. Restoring replaces the database file; the current database is snapshotted automatically first, and the change takes effect immediately — no control-plane restart needed.
backupPanel.emptyDesc: Press “Back up now” to create the first archive.
backupPanel.confirmTitle: Overwrite the current database with this backup?
backupPanel.confirmWarn: This replaces the current control-plane database with the selected backup. Current data will no longer be visible.
backupPanel.confirmSnapshot: A snapshot of the current database is saved automatically first, so you can restore it back if the result is not what you expected.
backupPanel.dirLocate: Backups are stored in the backups folder under the data directory.

remote.title: Remote backup (S3-compatible)
remote.desc: Local archives are encrypted before upload to S3-compatible storage. The key is read only from an environment variable; without it no upload runs at all. Restoring from remote downloads, verifies and decrypts the archive, then replaces the current database.
remote.refreshTitle: Re-read remote configuration, status and object list
remote.endpointHint: http(s)://host[:port], without a username or password
remote.keepHint: 1–90; after each successful upload, older objects beyond this count are deleted together with their sidecars
remote.keysNotice: Access key and secret key are not entered on this page; only the masked access key is shown here.
remote.keyMissingTitle: No encryption key configured — upload can never run
remote.keyMissingBody: The environment variable {env} is missing or is not a 32-byte base64 value. Without a key nothing is encrypted, and nothing is ever uploaded in plaintext, so neither manual nor scheduled uploads will run.
remote.authBlockedBody: The original error is below. After you change the connection settings and save, the next round clears the block automatically.
remote.unreachableBody: The endpoint, bucket or network is unreachable; the remote list and uploads will keep failing.
remote.notConfiguredBody: No outbound request happens until endpoint and bucket are saved; a manual upload would fail immediately.
remote.credsMissingBody: Endpoint and bucket are saved, but the environment has no credentials. Set {access} and {secret} (add {token} for temporary credentials), then restart the service.
remote.emptyDesc: After a local archive uploads successfully, its .zip.enc object appears here.
remote.uploadNoKey: No encryption key configured, so every upload is rejected
remote.uploadNotConfigured: Remote backup is not configured, so upload fails immediately
remote.deleteWarn: This deletes the object and its .sha256 sidecar. Once deleted, this copy cannot be restored from remote.
remote.restoreWarn: This overwrites the current database: existing data is replaced by the archive. If the process fails it rolls back automatically.
remote.restoreLocalWarn: Before running, make sure a usable local backup exists: it is the only fallback if the remote restore fails.
remote.restoreTypeName: Type the object name to confirm (must match exactly):

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Upstream proxy configuration, model alias mapping and console users
settings.reloadTitle: Re-read the upstream configuration and model list (upstream caches its own model list for 1 hour)
settings.cfgUnreadableHint: Make sure workbuddy2api is deployed and the path is correct (environment variable `WB_UPSTREAM_CONFIG`). Until it can be read, the settings below are locked so an empty configuration cannot overwrite the real file.
settings.authDirMismatch: The account directory declared in the upstream configuration differs from the one read here; this console uses the account directory shown above.
settings.modelsStaticTitle: When the live fetch fails, upstream falls back to its built-in static model table — a fixed list compiled into the binary, smaller than what is actually available. Use Refetch on the right to try again. This note can only appear with an older upstream (newer versions are purely dynamic and simply return an empty list).
settings.refetchModelsTitle: Fetch the model list from upstream again (upstream caches it for 1 hour)
settings.modelsNotFetched: No model list yet — check that the upstream container is running
settings.cfgNotReady: Configuration not ready, cannot fetch models
settings.modelsStaticNote: The live fetch failed, so the **static table compiled into the binary** is shown — fewer models than are actually available. Use Refetch to try again, or restart the upstream container and retry. (Newer upstream versions dropped that fallback table, so seeing this means the upstream is old.)
settings.modelsNote: The list is fetched by one healthy account chosen at random upstream, **so it depends on that account's authorization** — different accounts (enterprise / plan) may see different numbers of models. Upstream caches it for 1 hour.
settings.upstashDescOn: Session stickiness and account state are shared through Upstash, keeping multiple instances consistent
settings.upstashDescOff: Currently in-memory only (noop): state lives inside the container. That is normal for a single instance; configure Upstash when you scale out or want state to survive restarts
settings.upstashUrlHint: Copy the endpoint from the REST API section of the Upstash console
settings.upstashTokenHintSaved: The plaintext is never shown back for security; leaving it empty keeps the current value
settings.upstashTokenHint: Token that goes with the URL above
settings.upstashClearDesc: The Upstash URL and token will be cleared and upstream falls back to in-memory mode (noop). Upstream reloads automatically after saving.
settings.upstashFooter: Saving restarts upstream automatically so the change takes effect (about 0.5s; in-flight requests finish normally). Upstash connects when the container starts, so no manual restart is needed; if the configuration is wrong upstream degrades to noop with a warning and stays available.
settings.advancedDesc: Edit the raw JSON directly for parameters not covered above
settings.cfgNotLoaded: Upstream configuration not loaded; editing is disabled
settings.mapNewAliasDesc: Let downstream call a model by a name you already know. For example point `gpt-4o-mini` at `glm-5.2`.
settings.mapEmpty: No mappings yet; downstream can use the names from Available models above
settings.usersNewDesc: Administrators can add or remove accounts and change settings; read-only users can only look, which suits sharing status with colleagues.
settings.resetPasswordPrompt: Set a new password for “{name}” (at least 8 characters):
settings.passwordRelogin: Your current session was revoked; sign in again with the new password
settings.passwordOthersRevoked: All other sessions of that user were revoked
settings.deleteUserDesc: That user will no longer be able to sign in to the console.
settings.usersEmptyDesc: Keep at least one administrator account
settings.aboutDesc: This project provides the web console and public API gateway for workbuddy2api (a Tencent CodeBuddy → OpenAI-compatible proxy). Account rotation, concurrency and breakers are handled by workbuddy2api; this console handles account onboarding, key distribution, IP control, request logs and usage statistics.
settings.aboutCredits: The interface style draws on linux-do/cdk (MIT) — with thanks.
settings.aboutUsage: Downstream setup: use `https://your-domain/v1` as the Base URL and a `wbk_...` key issued on the API keys page.
settings.savedManualStep: Settings saved, but one manual step is required
settings.jsonInvalid: Invalid JSON — check the braces and commas
settings.jsonNotObject: It must be a JSON object, for example { "checkin_hours": [9, 21] }

runtime.title: Runtime settings
runtime.desc: Non-secret settings that affect gateway behavior. Stored in the database and applied immediately, no restart required.
runtime.transferDesc: Export the current runtime settings as JSON, or restore them from a backup.
runtime.importHint: Every item is validated before writing; one invalid value rejects the whole import. Successful imports apply immediately.
runtime.exportDesc: The file contains no secrets or credentials.
runtime.badFile: The file is not a valid JSON object

failover.title: Cross-provider failover
failover.desc: Whether a model found in several providers is retried in order. Saved values apply immediately; environment variables override this setting.
failover.enabledDesc: When off, a multi-provider catalog hit still returns 400 ambiguous_model.
failover.attemptsDesc: How many candidate providers one request may try before returning the last error.
failover.envLockedHint: Environment variable {vars} is set, so the UI controls do not change the effective value. Unset it to let UI config take over.
failover.contractDesc: Once enabled, a model found in multiple providers (same model, and all of them support this endpoint) no longer returns 400 ambiguous_model. Providers are tried in hit order and the request moves to the next one on failure, so callers may receive a response from a different provider.
failover.statsSeen: Observed {count} failover(s), {recent} attempt rows in the last 24 hours.
failover.statsSource: Stats come from the read-only [attempt N/M] markers in request logs; no new table is created.
failover.rangeError: Max attempts must be an integer between {min} and {max}

models_cache_ttl_sec.label: Model catalog cache TTL
models_cache_ttl_sec.desc: Seconds the upstream model list stays cached in this process. 0 refetches on every call; a larger value reduces upstream traffic but new models only appear after the cache expires. Default 60.

failure_window_sec.label: Failure rate window
failure_window_sec.desc: Sliding window (seconds) used to count failures per API key. Setting either this or the failure limit to 0 disables throttling. Default 60.

failure_window_max.label: Failures per window
failure_window_max.desc: Failures allowed for one API key within a window before returning 429. Only failed requests count. Default 20.

model_fallback_first.label: Unknown-model fallback
model_fallback_first.desc: When off, unknown model names return model_not_found. When on, they fall back to the first enabled provider that serves the endpoint. Off by default.

sse_max_seconds.label: Streaming request limit
sse_max_seconds.desc: Maximum seconds for one streaming response; after the timeout the stream is aborted and an SSE error frame is sent. Default 600.

session_ttl_sec.label: Login session lifetime
session_ttl_sec.desc: Lifetime in seconds for admin sessions. Only new logins are affected; existing sessions keep their original expiry. Default 86400.

estimate_usage.label: Estimated billing
estimate_usage.desc: When the upstream returns no usage, tokens are estimated from the request and response text and billed. The trade-off: estimated amounts count toward quota windows (quotas aggregate billing entries) and are not upstream truth. Logs mark these rows as Estimated, separate from Unpriced and No usage. Off by default.

alert_provider_failure_enabled.label: Provider failure streak alert
alert_provider_failure_enabled.desc: When off, this rule is not evaluated; existing alerts keep their state.

alert_provider_failure_streak.label: Failure streak threshold
alert_provider_failure_streak.desc: Consecutive failures of one provider within the window before alerting (1–100). Default 3.

alert_provider_failure_window_sec.label: Streak lookback window (sec)
alert_provider_failure_window_sec.desc: Lookback length used to count consecutive failures (60–86400). Default 86400.

alert_quota_remaining_enabled.label: Remaining quota alert
alert_quota_remaining_enabled.desc: When off, the remaining-quota threshold is not evaluated.

alert_quota_remaining_percent.label: Remaining quota threshold (%)
alert_quota_remaining_percent.desc: Alert when usage reaches this percentage (1–99; 100% is meaningless). Default 20.

alert_usage_missing_enabled.label: usage_missing ratio alert
alert_usage_missing_enabled.desc: When off, the usage_missing ratio is not evaluated.

alert_usage_missing_ratio_percent.label: usage_missing ratio threshold (%)
alert_usage_missing_ratio_percent.desc: Alert when the ratio in the window reaches this value (1–100). Default 50.

alert_usage_missing_min_requests.label: Minimum samples
alert_usage_missing_min_requests.desc: No alert below this sample size; small samples turn the ratio into noise, so the backend floor is 10. Default 20.

alert_usage_missing_window_sec.label: usage_missing window (sec)
alert_usage_missing_window_sec.desc: Time window used to compute the ratio (60–86400). Default 600.

settings.errHourRange: “{v}” is not an hour between 0 and 23
settings.errNoNewline: Line breaks and control characters are not allowed
settings.errEnum: Value is outside the allowed range
settings.displayDesc: This group only affects how **this browser** shows things — no system behavior changes, and it takes effect immediately.
settings.expiryDailyDesc: When on, the dashboard groups them by **calendar day**: credits expiring on the same day are summed instead of showing only the nearest one. Hovering still lists the amount and date of every entry.
settings.tokensAdminRequiredDesc: Access tokens can call the admin API without signing in (including minting gateway keys and changing the account pool), so they are limited to administrators. Ask an admin to set your role to admin under Settings → Users.
settings.tokensNewDesc: A long-lived credential for scripts / CI. It only authorises the admin API, not model calls. The plaintext is shown once, on creation.
settings.tokensCreatedDesc: Copy it now: the plaintext is shown only once.
settings.tokensEmptyDesc: Create a token so scripts / CI can call the admin API without logging in
settings.tokensDeleteDesc: Scripts using this token stop working immediately (401). This cannot be undone.
settings.tokensSessionOnlyHint: High-risk endpoints (updating, clearing logs, user management) still require a session login; tokens cannot call them.
settings.adminOnlyConfigDesc: Read-only accounts cannot view or change these settings. Contact an administrator if a change is needed.
settings.mmDesc: Export the current mapping as JSON; import it with merge or overwrite. A single invalid entry rejects the whole batch and writes nothing. A snapshot is taken before every real write, so you can roll back to the state before the last import.
settings.mmRollbackOk: Rolled back to the pre-import snapshot
settings.mmModeMerge: Merge: keep aliases absent from the import
settings.mmModeOverwrite: Overwrite: remove aliases absent from the import
settings.mmInput: Paste an export file or a mapping object
settings.mmNeedInput: Paste the content to import first
settings.mmNeedObject: The content must be a JSON object; the whole export file is accepted
settings.mmNoChange: Identical to the current mapping; nothing written
settings.mmRejectedDesc: Validation or the write failed, so no change was saved; per-entry reasons are below.
settings.mmReasonUnknownModel: Model not declared by the provider

phrases.派出失败: Failed to send out on a trip
phrases.等待响应头超时: Timed out waiting for response headers
phrases.登录状态已失效，请重新登录: Your session has expired; please sign in again
phrases.失败次数过多，请 10 分钟后再试: Too many failed attempts; try again in 10 minutes
phrases.密码至少 8 位: Password must be at least 8 characters
phrases.不能删除当前登录用户: You cannot delete the user you are signed in as
phrases.key_id 必须是数字或 all: key_id must be a number or all
phrases.每天自动领取免费额度；签到时的余额查询还能解冻被冷却的账号: Claims the free daily allowance; the balance query during check-in also unfreezes cooled-down accounts
phrases.在哪些整点执行签到（0-23，可多个）。签到时同时刷新余额并解冻冷却账号: Hours at which check-in runs (0-23, multiple allowed). It also refreshes the balance and unfreezes cooled-down accounts
phrases.自动推进「猫猫旅行」：领养 / 派出 / 领取到站奖励，可获得积分: Advances Cat travel automatically: adopt / send out / claim arrival rewards, earning credits
phrases.在哪些整点推进旅行（0-23，可多个）。默认两趟闭环：早上领奖并派出，晚上领当日: Hours at which travel advances (0-23, multiple allowed). The default two-round loop claims and sends out in the morning, then claims the day's reward in the evening
phrases.每日上报一次对话活跃，点亮连续登录并解锁领养前置任务（领猫需要）: Reports conversation activity once a day, keeping the login streak and unlocking the prerequisite task for adopting a cat
phrases.在哪些整点上报（0-23，可多个）。每号每天一次即可，重复上报无额外收益: Hours at which the report is sent (0-23, multiple allowed). Once per account per day is enough; repeats give no extra benefit
phrases.定期刷新登录令牌，避免账号因长期闲置掉线: Refreshes login tokens periodically so idle accounts do not drop offline
phrases.在哪些整点刷新令牌（0-23，可多个）: Hours at which tokens are refreshed (0-23, multiple allowed)
phrases.自动完成开学季任务中心的活动并抽空抽奖余额（仅国内版；国际版由脚本内部跳过）: Completes the school-season task centre activities and spends the lottery balance (China edition only; skipped internally for the Global edition)
phrases.在哪些整点执行开学季任务（0-23，可多个）。活动未开启时会自动跳过，不算失败: Hours at which school-season tasks run (0-23, multiple allowed). Skipped automatically — not counted as a failure — when the event is not open
phrases.在夜猫窗口（23:00–08:00）补做一次夜猫任务；窗口外会自动跳过: Runs the night-cat task once inside the night window (23:00–08:00); skipped outside the window
phrases.在哪些整点尝试夜猫任务（0-23，可多个）。默认凌晨 1 点；窗口内每天最多补一: Hours at which the night-cat task is attempted (0-23, multiple allowed). Defaults to 01:00; at most once per day inside the window
phrases.每个账号每次活跃上报发几条。领养猫需要 5 次对话，默认 5 条一次刷满；填 1: How many activity events each account sends per run. Adopting a cat needs 5 conversations, so the default of 5 fills it in one go; set 1 for the old behaviour
phrases.被腾讯限流后，账号冷却多久。数值越大越保守（格式如 600s / 10m / 1: How long an account cools down after Tencent rate-limits it. Larger is more conservative (format: 600s / 10m / 1h)
phrases.连续触发限流会逐次延长冷却，这是延长后的封顶值（格式如 2h）: Repeated rate limits extend the cooldown step by step; this caps that value (format: 2h)
phrases.一个账号同时处理几个请求。调大能提高吞吐，但更容易触发腾讯限流（0 = 不限制）: How many requests one account handles at once. Raising it increases throughput but makes Tencent rate limits more likely (0 = unlimited)
phrases.某账号连续失败多少次后，自动暂停使用它一段时间: How many consecutive failures an account may hit before it is paused for a while
phrases.被熔断的账号先等待多久（格式如 30m / 1h）: How long a tripped account waits first (format: 30m / 1h)
phrases.反复熔断会指数退避延长，这是封顶值（格式如 6h）: Repeated trips extend the cooldown exponentially; this caps it (format: 6h)
phrases.账号每闲置 1 小时增加一点调度权重，让久未使用的账号优先被选中: Each idle hour adds a little scheduling weight so long-unused accounts are picked first
phrases.闲置加成的封顶值，避免某个账号权重无限增大: Caps the idle bonus so one account's weight cannot grow without bound
phrases.上游的选号优化：长时间只用高成本档位时，每隔这么久会改走一次低成本档位探测，成功: An upstream account-picking optimisation: when only a high-cost tier has been used for a while, it switches to a low-cost tier to probe once every this interval, and stays there if it succeeds (saving credits). Empty = upstream default 30m, 0 = disable this optimisation
phrases.到期时间落在此窗口内的积分会被标记为「快过期」，选号时优先消耗掉，避免白白过期。: Credits expiring inside this window are marked as expiring soon and consumed first when picking an account, so they are not wasted. Empty or 0 disables the optimisation
phrases.对发往上游的请求做轻量脱敏，降低被判定异常的概率。除非在排查问题，否则建议保持开: Lightly sanitises outbound requests to reduce the chance of being flagged as anomalous. Keep it on unless you are debugging
phrases.同一会话的连续请求尽量路由到同一账号，多轮对话更连贯（多实例部署时依赖 Redi: Consecutive requests in one session are routed to the same account where possible, keeping multi-turn chats coherent (relies on Redis with multiple instances)
phrases.一次会话多久没活动就解除绑定（格式如 30m / 1h）: How long a session may sit idle before the binding is released (format: 30m / 1h)
phrases.后台多久清理一次过期会话（格式如 5m / 10m）: How often expired sessions are cleaned up in the background (format: 5m / 10m)
phrases.passthrough：原样透传客户端传来的 system 消息；custom：: passthrough: forward the client's system message untouched; custom: replace it with the gateway's own prompt
phrases.默认 passthrough 会把下游的 system prompt 原样送给上: The default passthrough sends the downstream system prompt to upstream unchanged. If you rely on the gateway's own prompt to stabilise behaviour (or to avoid the system fingerprint being flagged), switch to custom.
phrases.在 custom 与 append 模式下生效。留空使用内置默认提示词: Applies in both custom and append modes. Empty uses the built-in default prompt
phrases.路径必须存在于上游容器内且可读；写错会导致上游启动失败、反代不可用。不确定就留空: The path must exist and be readable inside the upstream container; a wrong value makes upstream fail to start and the gateway unavailable. Leave it empty if unsure.
phrases.单个请求体最大体积，超过返回 413。反代网关也按此值限制入站请求，调大可容纳更: Largest single request body; anything above returns 413. The gateway applies the same limit to inbound requests, so raising it allows longer contexts
phrases.网关向腾讯发起请求时使用的客户端标识，留空用内置默认（已对齐官方 WorkBud: Client identity the gateway uses towards Tencent; empty uses the built-in default (aligned with the official WorkBuddy)
phrases.用量归属头（X-Product / X-IDE-Name / X-IDE-Typ: Value for the usage-attribution headers (X-Product / X-IDE-Name / X-IDE-Type / X-IDE-Version); it affects the client shown on the official site. Empty = match the official desktop client (WorkBuddy); SaaS restores the old behaviour
phrases.出站 UA 里 WorkBuddy/<版本> 这段，也用于 X-IDE-Vers: The WorkBuddy/<version> part of the outbound UA, also used for the X-IDE-Version header. Empty = built-in default (aligned with the official distribution)
phrases.出站 UA 里 CLI/<版本> 这段。留空 = 内置默认: The CLI/<version> part of the outbound UA. Empty = built-in default
phrases.宿主上存放 device token 的文件路径，留空则不读文件。上游每 5 分: Path to the device token file on the host; empty means no file is read. Upstream reads it every 5 minutes and ignores read failures
phrases.留空 = 不读文件: empty = do not read a file
phrases.是否把客户端 IP（X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP）透传: Whether to forward the client IP (X-Forwarded-For / X-Real-IP) upstream. Off by default, so internal or proxy IPs are not exposed to upstream
phrases.开启后，realm=global 的账号走 workbuddy.ai（国际版模型: When on, realm=global accounts use workbuddy.ai (Global models and endpoints). Turning it off locks the deployment to China only: Global accounts are then sent to the China endpoints as if they were China accounts, which is a misconfiguration
phrases.国际版的聊天 / 登录 / 模型接口基址，留空用内置默认 https://www: Base URL for Global chat / login / model endpoints; empty uses the built-in default https://www.workbuddy.ai
Base URL for Global credit / trial endpoints; empty uses the built-in default https://www.workbuddy.ai
phrases.六类任务各自独立排程：签到 / 猫猫旅行 / 活跃上报 / 保活 / 开学季 /: Six task families are scheduled independently: check-in / cat travel / activity report / keep-alive / school season / night cat. Each can be toggled and given its own hours. Check-in, travel, activity report, school season and night cat **apply to China-edition accounts only** — the Global edition has none of these, only keep-alive runs as usual
phrases.网关如何对待客户端传来的 system / developer 消息: How the gateway treats system / developer messages from clients
phrases.被腾讯限流后的冷却策略: Cooldown policy after Tencent rate-limits an account
phrases.多轮对话的路由粘性与清理策略: Routing stickiness and cleanup for multi-turn conversations
phrases.控制账号池的并发能力与故障保护: Concurrency and failure protection for the account pool
phrases.网关自身的请求约束: Request constraints applied by the gateway itself
phrases.网关向腾讯发起请求时的客户端标识: Client identity the gateway uses when calling Tencent
phrases.国际版（workbuddy.ai）路由开关与基址。关闭即锁死纯 CN: Routing switch and base URLs for the Global edition (workbuddy.ai). Turning it off locks the deployment to China only
phrases.国际版单独用这个上限。国际版的风控更严，官方默认压到 2——并发越高越容易被判为: The global edition uses this limit separately. It is subject to stricter anti-abuse checks and officially defaults to 2 — higher concurrency is more likely to be flagged as abnormal traffic. Setting 0 means "use the default 2" (note this differs from the "0 = unlimited" above).
phrases.passthrough：原样透传客户端传来的 system 消息；custom：: passthrough: client system messages pass through unchanged; custom: the gateway replaces them with its own prompt; append: both — the gateway system is inserted after the leading system/developer blocks, leaving existing messages untouched
phrases.默认 passthrough 会把下游的 system prompt 原样送给上: The default passthrough sends the downstream system prompt upstream as-is. Switch to custom if you rely on the gateway prompt to stabilise behaviour (or to avoid the system fingerprint being flagged); use append when you want to keep the client system message and have the gateway prompt take effect too.
phrases.append（保留客户端 system，其后插入网关提示词）: append (keep client system, insert gateway prompt after it)
phrases.国际版无签到体系，已跳过: The Global edition has no check-in system; skipped
phrases.该账号无有效 accessToken: This account has no valid accessToken
phrases.领奖跳过：已到站但无记录 ID: Claim skipped: arrived but no record ID
phrases.领养跳过：对话数未达门槛，明天重试: Adoption skipped: conversation threshold not reached, retrying tomorrow
phrases.连续天数校验失败（上报本身成功）: Streak check failed (the report itself succeeded)
phrases.上报成功但连续天数仍为 0（疑似被静默丢弃）: Report succeeded but the streak is still 0 (possibly silently dropped)
phrases.抽奖跳过：无次数或未开启: Lottery skipped: no chances left or not enabled
phrases.计划任务未执行: The scheduled task did not run
phrases.账号页的「临时停用」走哪条路。**开启后**上游提供停用接口：停用只摘除转发流量: Which path the "pause" action on the Accounts page takes. **When enabled**, the upstream exposes pause endpoints: pausing only removes the account from traffic, while check-in and token keep-alive keep running (credits and credentials stay alive). When disabled, pausing falls back to renaming the file, which removes the account from the pool entirely and stops its tasks too. **Restart the upstream container** for a change to take effect (the upstream only reads this flag at startup).
phrases.仅对**旧版**上游生效：上游 9d1a21b 起已移除该配置、不再限制请求体大: Applies to **older** upstream versions only: the upstream removed this setting in 9d1a21b and no longer limits request body size. This gateway's own inbound limit is controlled by the WB_GATEWAY_MAX_BODY_MB environment variable (default 32 MB)
phrases.让「临时停用」只摘除转发流量（签到 / 保活照常、积分与凭证保持活跃）。不开启时: Makes "pause" remove the account from traffic only (check-in / keep-alive keep running, credits and credentials stay alive). When off, pausing falls back to renaming the file — the account leaves the pool entirely and its tasks stop. **Requires restarting the upstream container**; the upstream also requires a non-empty api_key, otherwise it refuses to start.

quotaPolicy.title: Quota Policies
quotaPolicy.desc: Set daily or monthly limits per key, optionally narrowed to a provider or model. Usage and alerts are tracked separately.
quotaPolicy.readonly: Read-only mode: only administrators can create, edit, or delete policies.
quotaPolicy.adminOnly: Quota data is only visible to administrators
quotaPolicy.adminOnlyDesc: Quota policies, current-period usage, and alert history are admin-only. Your account has no access.
quotaPolicy.deleteDesc: The policy and its thresholds are removed. Alert history is kept.
quotaPolicy.emptyPoliciesDesc: Set an amount or request limit for a key and alerts are recorded when thresholds are reached.
quotaPolicy.emptyPoliciesReadonly: No quota policies yet. Ask an administrator to create one.
quotaPolicy.formDesc: Unique by (key, provider, model, window). Submitting the same combination updates the existing policy and replaces all thresholds.
quotaPolicy.identityLocked: Key, scope, and window form the policy key and cannot be changed while editing.
quotaPolicy.amountHint: This is a limit, not current usage. 0 means unlimited.
quotaPolicy.requestsHint: This is a limit, not current usage. 0 means unlimited.
quotaPolicy.thresholdsHint: Percentages separated by commas; each threshold alerts once per period
quotaPolicy.invalidAmount: Amount limit must be a number ≥ 0
quotaPolicy.invalidRequests: Request limit must be an integer ≥ 0
quotaPolicy.invalidThresholds: Thresholds must be integers from 1 to 1000, separated by commas
quotaPolicy.bothZero: Set at least one of amount limit and request limit
quotaPolicy.usageDesc: Pick a key to see usage, remaining balance, and reset time. Exceeded policies are highlighted.
